title: Encrypted Messaging Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your messaging privacy risk score. Assess your encrypted messaging habits and get personalized recommendations for secure communication.
description: Evaluate your messaging privacy risks and discover vulnerabilities in your communication habits. Get a personalized risk score and actionable recommendations to improve your encrypted messaging security across Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, and other platforms.

formula: let appRisk = {'default': 10, 'opt-in': 35, 'none': 80, 'unsure': 70}[chatEncryption] ?? 70; let backupRisk = backupEnabled === 'yes' ? 30: (backupEnabled === 'unsure' ? 20: 0); let groupRisk = Math.min(groupChats * 1.5, 30); let contentRisk = {'never': 0, 'rarely': 10, 'sometimes': 25, 'often': 40}[sensitiveContent] ?? 25; let disappearingRisk = {'always': 0, 'sometimes': 10, 'no': 20, 'unavailable': 15}[disappearingMessages] ?? 20; let contactRisk = contactsOnInsecure * 0.3; let totalRisk = Math.round(Math.min(appRisk + backupRisk + groupRisk + contentRisk + disappearingRisk + contactRisk, 100)); let grade = totalRisk <= 20 ? 'A': totalRisk <= 40 ? 'B': totalRisk <= 60 ? 'C': totalRisk <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; let concerns = []; if(appRisk >= 30) concerns.push('Insecure messaging app'); if(backupRisk >= 20) concerns.push('Cloud backup exposure'); if(contentRisk >= 25) concerns.push('Sensitive content sharing'); if(contactRisk >= 25) concerns.push('Insecure contacts'); let primaryConcern = concerns[0] ?? 'Metadata collection'; return { riskScore: totalRisk, riskGrade: grade, primaryConcern: primaryConcern };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates messaging privacy risks based on whether your app encrypts chats end to end by default, backup practices, group chat exposure, content sensitivity, disappearing message usage, and contact security habits. Scores range from 0 (most secure) to 100 (highest risk).
tips: Use an app that encrypts every chat end to end by default and keeps little metadata about who you talk to, such as Signal
Turn off cloud backups of your chats, or turn on end-to-end encrypted backups if your app offers them
Enable disappearing messages for sensitive conversations to limit data retention
Check which computers and browsers are linked to your account, and unlink any you don't recognize
Regularly audit your group chats and leave unnecessary ones to reduce exposure
